note: Per-round ledger of this target's review history. The commit/merge gate keys freshness on the sibling record (<key>.json) — a fresh review of the exact reviewed bytes — but --record now refuses to file a record unless this ledger's last round reviewed those same bytes, so a record can never be filed for content the ledger never saw. This file is the history the record itself cannot carry: what each round found, what was fixed, what was refuted by execution. Rounds are appended in order; a header key already present is never rewritten or dropped by a later append.

findings_fixed: Process substitution (deepseek, glm, minimax; found independently mid-round): less-than-paren and greater-than-paren are substitutions outside double quotes, their interiors get the commit check, and any process substitution from the first commit-mentioning command onward denies. The chained-inspection false deny (deepseek) is fixed by the unified rule: a later command needs the prefix only if the commit text reaches it through a pipe, heredoc or written file, so unrelated later commands such as git diff are free. Comment inside dollar-paren (glm): the paren scanner now skips a hash comment to end of line. Quoted double-dash after env (glm): compared by text. Beyond the panel, a Docker harness running 1577 commands through real bash 5.2 found 21 false grants the parser had on this tip (a prefixed commit beside an unprefixed sh -c or eval commit) and drove the unified rule and heredoc support.
findings_refuted_or_deferred: minimax: a hatch prefix before a parenthesised subshell — to be confirmed against real bash; an assignment cannot prefix a subshell, so no commit runs.
